'''Green Leader''' was a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the pilot escorted the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' past [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], alongside [[Green Two (Battle of Hoth)|Green Two]].
